rows.reason: AI runtime needs one lifecycle mount without creating a second Control Plane.
contract: Inject one killable non-critical managed port
Require typed start, stop, probe, bounded resources and AI-off semantics.
tests: Prove start, stop and probe failure paths
Prove boot, recovery and shutdown with AI directory, service and provider absent.
expectedBehavior: Core startup, operation, recovery and shutdown remain unchanged when AI is absent or unavailable
No second lifecycle owner.

rows.reason: AI reads and proposals need authenticated Product-plane ingress without a second API authority.
contract: Add bounded AI-Ops read, chat and proposal request and response schemas behind existing operator middleware.
tests: Run authenticated and unauthenticated route tests
Reject malformed, oversized and mutation-bearing read or chat payloads.
expectedBehavior: Strict bounded responses preserve unknown and unavailable truth
Read and chat routes cannot mutate canonical state.

rows.reason: Durable AI records must use the sole canonical persistence owner.
contract: Add Ledger migrations and adapters for cases, transitions, inbox, outbox, DLQ, attempts, effects, usage, approvals, evidence hashes and retention pointers.
tests: Prove backup, restore, restart, replay, compare-and-set conflict and corrupt-record failure behavior.
expectedBehavior: Zero acknowledged authoritative-record loss
One Ledger
No second store or file journal.

rows.reason: Lane-local work cannot edit shared scripts, dependencies or lockfiles.
contract: Apply only dependency and script deltas named by sealed accepted lane receipts.
tests: Run lockfile integrity, offline network-free tests, license and security checks, and dependency-necessity checks.
expectedBehavior: Only reviewed necessary packages and scripts land
Lanes remain buildable without hidden network or provider calls.

rows.reason: Eligible case transitions need the existing durable material-event channel.
contract: Add ratified AI case-transition kinds and projections to the canonical material stream.
tests: Prove stable identity, occurrence and observation time, dedupe, bounded page, cursor continuity, reconnect and gap handling.
expectedBehavior: No new bus, socket or cursor
Consumers see ordered durable eligible transitions or explicit gaps.

rows.reason: Deterministic campaigns exist only as pure vocabulary and cannot silently become an executor.
contract: Ratify a typed action-request contract, registered runbooks, durable checkpoint and existing-effect-owner bindings
Never create an AI executor.
tests: Prove lease, fence, idempotency, precondition, postcondition, quiet period, checkpoint, restart and forbidden-action failure cases.
expectedBehavior: OP_LOCAL_REMEDIATION_CAMPAIGN stays unavailable until mounted
Effects run only through existing owners
Money capabilities remain impossible.

rows.reason: Atlas and diagnostic evidence must remain bound to accepted owners and release identity.
contract: Bind accepted Atlas catalog owner and diagnostic-boundary projections through narrow owner adapters.
tests: Validate owner, release, tested-commit, subject and digest tuples
Run hostile substitution, splice, empty-corpus and fixture-promotion tests.
expectedBehavior: Synthetic and generated projections never mint live green
Missing owner or catalog stays UNKNOWN or MISSING.

rows.reason: AI queue, drop, lag, provider, case and resource facts need canonical health projection.
contract: Register bounded observations without a second telemetry or health authority.
tests: Inject missing, stale, future, dropped, saturated and provider-outage evidence
Run core non-degradation soak.
expectedBehavior: Missing telemetry is MISSING or SILENT
Authority downgrades
Core service remains within signed overhead budgets.

rows.reason: AI reset and reconnect cannot invent a second reset or restart owner.
contract: Reuse only public news, calendar and fx targets
Add managed or AI actions solely as ratified canonical command projections.
tests: Prove public target success
Prove managed all, market and runtime targets are preview-only HTTP 409
Prove account remains not configured
Require receipt and readback for any future action.
expectedBehavior: No second reset API, restart owner or cadence owner
Unavailable actions remain honest.

rows.reason: Current surface is an in-app routing projection only; no canonical incident-linked external delivery owner exists.
contract: After incident-owner ratification, bind page, acknowledgement, escalation and delivery
External email, Telegram, WhatsApp and SNS remain NOT_CONFIGURED
AWS intake remains OWNER_GATED.
tests: Prove destination acceptance and readback, dedupe, expiry, acknowledgement race and delivery-loss alarm using fake endpoints only.
expectedBehavior: No external notification is claimed without an owner receipt
Loss and unavailable destinations are operator-visible.

rows.targetSeam: Owner and path MISSING; evidence at server/src/productIntegration/runtime/projection.ts::buildProductRuntimeSupervisorEnvelope
rows.reason: Incident identity, grouping, fingerprint, severity and lifecycle have no canonical owner.
contract: Director ratifies one owner
A2 supplies only a typed admission projection after ratification.
tests: Prove grouping, split, merge, reopen, close, acknowledgement races, dedupe, persistence and hostile false-green behavior.
expectedBehavior: INCIDENT_OWNER_NOT_CONFIGURED changes only with an owner receipt
Ledger remains persistence, not policy.

rows.reason: Evaluator vocabulary exists but no independently deployed sentinel owner is configured.
contract: Bind an external read-only sentinel in a separate failure domain with no trading or patch authority.
tests: Prove independent liveness and readback, stale or missing delivery, main-app outage and sentinel-outage fault cases.
expectedBehavior: Sentinel reports independently and fail-closed
It cannot execute, trade, patch or mint product readiness.

rows.targetSeam: Production owner MISSING; S6 append and retention receipt contracts; canonical Ledger insertion seam
rows.reason: AI provenance requires independently administered append-only or WORM delivery distinct from sentinel execution.
contract: Ratify audit retention, delivery, readback, chain or hash and restoration contract through the canonical Ledger owner.
tests: Prove append chain, tamper detection, delivery loss, retention expiry, restore and independent readback.
expectedBehavior: Audit loss is visible within the signed interval
No worker can rewrite or delete evidence or administer its own audit sink.

rows.reason: Mounted AI components need canonical inventory and supervisor truth.
contract: Insert only ratified AI identities, availability, blockers and component posture into Product runtime projections.
tests: Prove absent, starting, healthy, degraded, unavailable and killed states plus exact blocker propagation.
expectedBehavior: Cockpit receives canonical server truth
AI absence cannot degrade or falsify core readiness.

rows.targetSeam: Production owner and path MISSING; Product command preview and result types are evidence only, not a generic ApprovalRequest or ApprovalReceipt owner
rows.reason: Elevated AI proposals require separately authenticated human approval that no AI or service can satisfy.
contract: Ratify typed approval request and receipt binding artifact, parameters, expiry, principal, reauthentication and execution readback.
tests: Prove expiry, replay, parameter substitution, AI-as-approver, inherited-chat and credential or role confusion failures.
expectedBehavior: Only the authenticated human owner approves
Preview is never approval
Release service executes only the exact approved artifact.

rows.reason: Browser and synthetic evidence must extend existing probe and connection truth, not create a new health authority.
contract: Add AI surface observations and independent synthetic probes through existing authenticated and readback seams.
tests: Run fake or offline probe, browser-observation schema, stale, future, timeout, restart and visible-unavailable tests.
expectedBehavior: Browser reports observations only
Server remains health authority
Probe failure is explicit and never decorative green.

rows.reason: Accepted lane gates need one canonical root acceptance mount.
contract: Register sealed lane tests and AI-off or fault gates only after acceptance.
tests: Run focused lane suites, network-free root suite, complete acceptance, hostile false-green and exact exit-code checks.
expectedBehavior: Real failures return nonzero
No fake success
Accepted counts and commands are recorded in canonical state and receipt.
